steps.title: Configure App Meta and Specifications
steps.description: Configure package name com.studyplanner.app and define the schema for subjects and tasks collections.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app build.gradle with proper compile and target SDK 34 versions and standard dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Declare permissions for internet connectivity and registration of all activities in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create App String Resources
steps.description: Define the missing app_name string and other XML values in strings.xml to fix AAPT build errors.

steps.title: Create Backend API Client
steps.description: Develop BackendApi.java helper to handle user authentication, forgot-password OTP, and generic dynamic CRUD operations.

steps.title: Implement Login Layout and Activity
steps.description: Create the user login interface, connecting UI inputs to the authentication endpoint and managing tokens.

steps.title: Implement Register Layout and Activity
steps.description: Create registration screen where students sign up and trigger an automatic login upon successful registration.

steps.title: Implement Forgot Password Layout and Activity
steps.description: Implement standard 2-step OTP verification workflow sending recovery emails through Gmail via cloud backend API.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Layout and Activity
steps.description: Create Main Dashboard showing study statistical calculation calculations, task completion rates, and navigation menu.

steps.title: Implement Subject Management Layout and Activity
steps.description: Allow students to add, update, and remove academic subjects with study hours targets.

steps.title: Implement Task Management and Interactive Study Timer Layout and Activity
steps.description: Provide functional list tracking, search, task checkboxes, and interactive study stop-watch timer to log and save local study minutes.

steps.title: Building Study Planner
steps.description: Compile, build, and assemble debug APK.
